provider_receipt.summary: Approved with no named defects. Independent source inspection confirms the parent summary: Tool Gate evaluates caller-supplied metadata as a deterministic pre-execution policy gate, returns allow, deny, or review_required receipts, does not execute tools, and explicitly delegates authentication, authorization, sandboxing, and execution to callers. Although the parent’s direct README extraction exited -1, its successful line-scoped git-blame evidence covers the cited claims, and the successful clean-tree evidence supports the no-modification assertion.
